N-add09a#1.t: Hey... you lot up front, halt!

N-add09a#3.zh: 劝你们还是睁一眼闭一眼让我们过去的好，省得讨打！
N-add09a#3.t: Take my advice: look the other way and let us pass, and spare yourselves a beating!

N-add09a#4.zh: 好家伙，口气不小！大家上，把他们统统抓回去领赏！
N-add09a#4.t: Big talk! Everyone, get them! We'll haul the lot back for the reward!

N-add09a#6.zh: 胜利条件   --- 打败所有敌人

N-add09a#10.zh: 胜利条件   --- 打败县尉

N-add09a#12.zh: 限制回合数已到，未完成任务，游戏失败！

N-add09a#13.zh: %N死亡，群龙无首，四下逃散，最终仍为官兵捕获，押解回东京，无一得以善终........
N-add09a#13.t: %N died. Leaderless, the group scattered, but the soldiers caught them anyway and took them back to Kaifeng. None came to a good end........
